claims.text: The n8n workflow processes bank statements or invoice PDFs into structured data while verifying the arithmetic of every row against the statement's balance.
The n8n library contains 17 paid listings for document or PDF extraction compared to 177 free listings.
Eleven of the seventeen paid document extraction listings on n8n are specifically for resume screening.
The design philosophy mandates that the AI model must never handle a numerical value that it could potentially fabricate.
The workflow uses deterministic methods to extract values and restricts the LLM to assigning columns, followed by arithmetic verification to ensure accuracy.
The demo PDF contains three specific challenges: wrapped descriptions, transactions split across page breaks, and accounting parentheses for negative values.
Overlapping columns in a PDF's text layer are a flaw in the source document itself that cannot be resolved by the parser.
In a real n8n v2.35.7 test, the digital PDF parsing achieved 100 percent reconciliation across 16 rows.
A test using a vision model to OCR an image-only PDF and process it through reconciliation nodes confirmed the end-to-end viability of the extraction path.
In a test of 16 rows, the LLM node correctly structured 15 rows while mislabeling one salary disbursement as a credit.
The reconciliation process is designed to catch model errors on a row-by-row basis, even when the closing balances match.
While extraction has been proven on an 86-row card statement, the system has not yet been reconciled against a real statement containing a balance column.
Google Gemini is a preferable choice for long-running pipelines on a free tier because Groq's free tier imposes a daily token limit that can cause silent batch failures.
When using local HTTP services on Windows, Node 24's fetch function may prioritize IPv6, requiring developers to explicitly use 127.0.0.1 in the base URL.
JavaScript's Date constructor can silently corrupt dates where the day is 12 or less by misinterpreting them as months.
The system now infers the decimal separator by identifying the last symbol between a dot and a comma within the document to avoid incorrect parsing of European currency formats.
